text.text:
If you would like to learn more about each individual
component, please open their respective example
level for more detailed information as this level is
about how they can interact and how to make those
interactions possible.

This Hidden Target BP can be used to select Actors
like Springs, Vertical Ziplines, Jump Pads and Rails
so the Character can interact with those Actors with
the Homing Attack.

The Hidden Target BP is attached to those Actors.

To attach the Hidden Target BP to other Actors first
we add the parent Actor reference. The Hidden Target
will be attached to the root component of the parent
Actor. You can set -Snap to Target?- False to move
the Hidden Target to a different location relative to
the parent Actor.

The Vertical Zipline will attach the Hidden Target to
the Sphere Collision (Pulley).

The Hidden Target only has collision with the custom
Trace Channel used by the Homing Attack component
so it won't be destroyed.

Please use this level as reference and see how the
different Actors can be added so they can interact with
each other. For example, we can add a Hidden Target
to an end of a Rail close to the surface but for Ziplines
it needs to be moved below the cable. With Springs we
can place the Hidden Target also at the surface.

Parallel Rail Jumps

Jumping between rails in this demo is done by pressing
Q or the Gamepad Right Shoulder button while holding
the movement input and aiming at the desired direction.

Rail Loops

Rail loops can be created by selecting the option [Create
Closed Loop Rail?] on each individual rail. This will close
the rail spline using the first and last spline points. The
spline mesh needs to be adjusted using the spline tool
so that the spline aligns with the mesh.

To create circle loops set the option [Circle Loop Rail?]
to True.

Vertical Rail Loops

Vertical Rail loops can be created by selecting the option
[Create Vertical Rail Loop?] on each individual rail. The
character will be able to grind on rails upside down. Make
sure to rotate the spline points so they do not twist or
bend incorrectly. If not then the character will rotate to
the sides while using the rails.

Select [Closed Vertical Loop?] to close the spline rail.
